SELECT COUNT(*) as totalBudgets, SUM(CASE WHEN BUDGET_STATUS IN ('待编制', '编制中') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as compilationBudgets, SUM(CASE WHEN BUDGET_STATUS = '执行中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as executionBudgets, SUM(CASE WHEN BUDGET_STATUS = '已完成' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedBudgets, COALESCE(SUM(TOTAL_BUDGET_AMOUNT), 0) as totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(EXECUTED_AMOUNT), 0) as executedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(REMAINING_BUDGET), 0) as remainingAmount, CASE WHEN SUM(TOTAL_BUDGET_AMOUNT) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(EXECUTED_AMOUNT) / SUM(TOTAL_BUDGET_AMOUNT) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as executionRate FROM GZCT_BUDGET_MANAGEMENT WHERE (ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} OR ENTERPRISE_ID = 'ALL') AND DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT BUDGET_TYPE as budgetType, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GZCT_BUDGET_MANAGEMENT WHERE (ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} OR ENTERPRISE_ID = 'ALL') AND DEL_FLAG = '0'), 2) as percentage FROM GZCT_BUDGET_MANAGEMENT WHERE (ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} OR ENTERPRISE_ID = 'ALL') AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY BUDGET_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT BUDGET_STATUS as budgetStatus, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GZCT_BUDGET_MANAGEMENT WHERE (ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} OR ENTERPRISE_ID = 'ALL') AND DEL_FLAG = '0'), 2) as percentage FROM GZCT_BUDGET_MANAGEMENT WHERE (ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} OR ENTERPRISE_ID = 'ALL') AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY BUDGET_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT APPROVAL_STATUS as approvalStatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM GZCT_BUDGET_MANAGEMENT WHERE (ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} OR ENTERPRISE_ID = 'ALL') AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY APPROVAL_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN EXECUTION_RATE >= 90 THEN '90%以上' WHEN EXECUTION_RATE >= 70 THEN '70%-90%' WHEN EXECUTION_RATE >= 50 THEN '50%-70%' WHEN EXECUTION_RATE >= 30 THEN '30%-50%' ELSE '30%以下' END as rateRange, COUNT(*) as count FROM GZCT_BUDGET_MANAGEMENT WHERE (ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} OR ENTERPRISE_ID = 'ALL') AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND EXECUTION_RATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN EXECUTION_RATE >= 90 THEN '90%以上' WHEN EXECUTION_RATE >= 70 THEN '70%-90%' WHEN EXECUTION_RATE >= 50 THEN '50%-70%' WHEN EXECUTION_RATE >= 30 THEN '30%-50%' ELSE '30%以下' END ORDER BY count DESC
